title: Immaculate Constellation USAP managed by DoD but held at the White House
summary: Michael Shellenberger tells of Immaculate Constellation USAP managed by DoD but held at the White House, about 2024 at Washington, D.C., and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Immaculate Constellation actually an old NSC-owned mission

plain: Immaculate Constellation is the name of what is said to be a secret US government program about UFOs. It is described as a USAP, an unacknowledged special access program, meaning a secret project whose existence the government does not admit. In 2024 a journalist, Michael Shellenberger, published a report about it. He says that after he published, he was told the program was managed by the Department of Defense, the Pentagon, but held at the White House. A man who describes himself as a Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, tells it differently. He says the program is run and owned by the National Security Council, the President's own security advisers in the White House, and that it is an old mission from before 2017. If true, it would mean UFO secrets are kept at the very top of the US government.
